## 2. Service Offerings

### 2.1 Managed IT Support & Infrastructure Maintenance
- 24/7/365 remote and on-site helpdesk ticketing.
- Enterprise workstation provisioning and Active Directory configuration.
- Cisco switch/router setups, corporate Wi-Fi segmentation, VLAN design, and QoS management.
- Zero-Trust cybersecurity audits, automated patch management, and threat intelligence.
- Database administration, automated backup verification, and disaster recovery replication.

### 2.2 Bespoke Custom Software Development
- Modern Web Apps: Built with React, Next.js, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.
- Backend & APIs: Node.js, Express, Python FastAPI, RESTful & GraphQL architecture.
- Database Engineering: PostgreSQL, Supabase, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis caching.
- Cloud Integrations: AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions, Azure App Services.
- Mobile Applications: Cross-platform iOS & Android engineering via Flutter and React Native.

### 2.3 Cloud Migration & DevOps Engineering
- Full migration pipelines from on-premises bare metal to AWS, GCP, or Azure.
- Containerization: Docker container builds, Docker Compose, and Kubernetes (K8s) clusters.
- CI/CD Pipelines: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI automated testing, staging, and zero-downtime production releases.
- Security & Compliance: ISO 27001 readiness, HIPAA considerations, and PCI-DSS compliance audits.

### 2.4 Dedicated Developer Staffing & Emergency Manpower
- Pre-vetted, background-checked full-stack developers, frontend specialists, DevOps engineers, and system admins.
- Flexible engagement models: Full-time dedicated squads or part-time staff augmentation.
- Scale up or down with 15-day notice, eliminating traditional recruitment friction.

## 3. SLA & Response Guarantees
- Priority 1 (System Down / Outage): Response in < 30 minutes, dedicated engineer assigned immediately.
- Priority 2 (Severe Degradation): Response in < 2 hours.
- Priority 3 (Feature Request / Minor Issue): Response in < 6 hours.
- 99.9% Uptime guarantee for managed cloud servers.
